admission: The completed rebase review covered 39 releases and 362 commits from 7.3.15 through the frozen 8.0.33 tag; those fix dispositions remain below as review history. The pinned-to-reviewed tag interval is now empty, with the two original admitted post-tag tails recorded separately under target.cherry_picks and the bounded tool-call-integrity adaptation recorded in fixes[]. cli-proxy-api-initial-registration.patch (admission 31) is a local fix with no upstream commit: on 8.0.33 a queued model registration is skipped whenever the credential's generation advanced after the task was queued, and ordinary bookkeeping (a request result, refresh scheduling, cooldown or quota state) advances it without changing what the credential registers, so a newly loaded credential can serve with no models. The patch removes only that generation-based skip; the disabled and removed checks and the registration fences stay. A fix is backported now, as an admitted patch with its own failing-without-the-fix tests and a gate record, only when it is reachable in the configuration charmer renders and it protects stored credentials or the availability of sign-in or API-key routes. Everything else is carried by the rebase onto the 8.x line or needs no action.
rendered_configuration: listener on 127.0.0.1 only, every client authenticated by the gateway API key
plugins.enabled false, Home off, discovery off, pprof off
logging-to-file false and no request-log key (request logging off; error logs of failed requests are still forced)
disable-cooling true for every credential, no request-scoped error rules, no per-credential or per-provider cooling override
management only through the environment key and the read-only allowlist on the Nix channel, otherwise off
request-retry 0, max-retry-credentials 1, fill-first routing; one auto-refresh loop per process with 16 workers
--local-model on every gateway run/login; no models: section (effective models {}), so catalogs stay embedded; 2.1.0 never renders models.catalog or other catalog file/URL overrides
remote-management.disable-control-panel true and disable-auto-update-panel true; github-token omitted (effective empty); 2.1.0 never renders github-token
signin-with-chatgpt-identifier omitted and no SIWC sign-in or --siwc-bind; 2.1.0 keeps SIWC unrendered and never passes --siwc-bind
routing.session-affinity true with session-affinity-ttl 24h; session-affinity-rebind-on absent (effective any); unchanged for 2.1.0
max-request-body-bytes absent (effective 0, unlimited); not adopted in 2.1.0 without a large-context body probe
streaming.send-keepalive-before-ft absent (effective false); refused for 2.1.0, not emitted by the rendered-key allowlist
upstream.claude.tool-search and claude-api-key native-tool-search absent (effective false); not adopted or rendered in 2.1.0

tls-handshake-timeout-seconds 20 makes the configured handshake timeout and retry reachable; the healthy-slow-handshake decision remains pending traffic and HTTP/1.1 proxy validation, and the setting is dropped if that validation rejects healthy slow handshakes
claude-header-defaults overrides and client-request-id absent (effective empty client-request-id means on); no such overrides rendered in 2.1.0

oauth-excluded-models: {pool: ["*"]} for pools moved to a reviewed keyed transport (render.py:1210-1218); charmer writes no per-credential excluded_models but records may contain it; 2.1.0 keeps global exclusions authoritative via the additive P15 hunk, including after reload

These are current-render assumptions plus explicitly planned 2.1.0 changes, not a claim that the planned ports have shipped. Any rendered-configuration change reopens the affected reachability reasons before it is merged.

The module-requirements patch pins Go-compatible x/net 0.61.0, x/crypto 0.58.0, x/sys 0.49.0, x/text 0.43.0, x/sync 0.24.0, compress 1.20.3 and go-git v6.0.0-beta.1. fixes.subject: feat(registry): custom model catalog sources and dynamic reload; Devin catalog off for Home

L0 choice: rebase cli-proxy-api-oauth-model-overlay.patch (P15), not replace it with models.catalog. CatalogSources selects a process-wide catalog from a file or URL; it does not provide the closed, per-OAuth-channel additive overlay with no header/transport overrides and whole-load refusal on invalid input. Keep that contract and static-wins precedence, refresh the pinned registry snapshot and prove static/overlay collisions at L4. The service_models.go port must also carry the additive global oauth-excluded-models hunk: a credential's excluded_models must never replace the global exclusion, with an own-red seeded-record test and an L4 GET /v1/models check after reload (see b015f208). models.catalog is never rendered in 2.1.0; the L5 no-egress test asserts embedded catalogs. After the v8.0.33 registry refresh, claude-sonnet-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol are static: gpt-6.1-sol is then served only to team, plus and pro Codex credentials (the overlay served it to every Codex credential), the sonnet qualification text is updated, and the XC probe needs an overlay-only wire the v8.0.33 registry lacks.

fixes.reason: Arrives with the tag: Server.cfgMu/getConfig, BaseAPIHandler.runtimeMu/CurrentConfig and the watcher configApplyMu. The server-config-snapshot patch shrinks to its residual: one snapshot pinned per request or connection, plus the existing race gates. About 25 call sites still re-read CurrentConfig, for example handlers.go:635 and handlers_errors.go:131. L0 choice: drop cli-proxy-api-plugin-host-locking.patch (P13): upstream now locks SetPluginHost/SetModelRouterHost and supplies ModelRouterHostSnapshot (handlers.go:470-506). The remaining model-list double sample of interceptorHost (handlers_interceptors.go:659 and newRequestLifecycleTracker at :124) is dormant with plugins disabled; enabling plugins reopens it. Drop only after porting TestCM053PluginHostConcurrentModelInterception, TestCM053PluginHostConcurrentExecutorLookup and TestCM053PluginHostTypedNilAndReentrantCallback to the v8 API and showing all three green without P13 for 100 runs with -race. Then remove those three selections from the race-handlers gate along with the retired patch; do not remove them before collecting that evidence.

fixes.reason: Reachability changes for 2.1.0: the render sets tls-handshake-timeout-seconds to 20 rather than the upstream default 0 (unbounded). The configured handshake timeout and its retry are reachable, not dormant. The bound starts after dialing and proxy CONNECT and ends with TLS establishment, not inference or SSE. L4 and the proxy-url lane must cover silent handshakes, cancellation, slow but healthy handshakes and the HTTP/1.1-only intercepting proxy; drop the 20 s bound if those lanes show it rejecting healthy handshakes. The credentialed-redirects port must cover the timeout wrapper and retry path. No contrary L0 evidence justifies keeping 0.

fixes.subject: Claude preserved-thinking block binding (thinking-binding-controls beta), adaptive synthesis, between_tools disable type and registry thinking facts
fixes.reason: Arrives with the tag and changes native Claude Code requests. On opus-5-5, sonnet-5-5, haiku-5-5 and fable-5-1, a history with signed thinking gets thinking.block_binding.prefix_mismatch_behavior=drop_block plus the beta, in every fingerprint mode. Disabled thinking becomes between_tools or low adaptive wherever the registry now says zero_allowed false: ad9e456d sets that for claude-fable-5, claude-fable-5-1 and claude-opus-5-5, and removes budget min/max on fable-5, fable-5-1, opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 (not rendered), adding dynamic_allowed on those entries. This turns 400s into served requests (#6697, #6698). L4 records them as named exact-client deltas and re-proves the effort, thinking and Kimi filter-thinking contracts. No payload filter, because it would bring the 400s back.

fixes.subject: feat(auth): prevent stale file snapshots from overwriting later persisted state
fixes.reason: Arrives with the tag and meets the admission rule on stored credentials: an unversioned file-synthesised snapshot can no longer overwrite a later persisted credential (#6709). The serve-after-initial-auth-load and credential-save-report ports follow its digest-bound snapshots (internal/watcher/dispatcher.go, synthesizer/file.go, conductor_lifecycle.go).

fixes.subject: OAuth excluded-models priority, tolerant load of invalid excluded_models, plugin exclusions
fixes.reason: Reachable and a no-silent-credential-fallback blocker for the rebase. render.py:1210-1218 emits oauth-excluded-models: {pool: ["*"]} for every pool whose provider moves to a reviewed keyed transport. charmer writes no per-credential excluded_models, but imported or copied sign-in records can carry it and charmer never opens them. v7.3.15 merged the per-account and global lists (internal/watcher/synthesizer/helpers.go:78-83); v8.0.33 lets a non-empty credential excluded_models replace the global rule (sdk/cliproxy/service_models.go:73-81), so such a record can serve OAuth models while served_plan.py:329 reports the pool excluded. L2 must-fix: add the authoritative global exclusion back additively in cli-proxy-api-oauth-model-overlay.patch (P15), at its service_models.go port; a credential's list must not weaken the global list. Require an own-red test with a seeded record carrying non-empty excluded_models and an L4 served-models check that GET /v1/models lists none of the excluded pool's models after a reload. 1a28c61e keeps a credential loading when its own field is invalid; that availability change remains, but cannot bypass the global exclusion. Write-side validation is management and default-denied.

fixes.reason: Admitted cherry-pick (access-log integrity). It ships verbatim with its test as series patch cli-proxy-api-access-log-path-quoting.patch in the 8.0.33 rebase, as a backport beyond the frozen tag. Reachable: every request, authenticated or not, is access-logged, and %0A in the path splits the line (#6731). It protects the persistence-hold evidence that gates gateway stops and restarts. Applies cleanly to v8.0.33; port size unchanged (144/139).

fixes.subject: feat(auth): increase Codex proactive refresh lead to 96 hours and improve rejected token handling
fixes.reason: Admitted as a partial cherry-pick, shipped as cli-proxy-api-codex-refresh-lead.patch. Only the 96 h CodexOuterRefreshLead is taken: sdk/auth/codex.go RefreshLead, plus the constant and the codex default in sdk/cliproxy/auth/types.go. Meets the admission rule: Codex OAuth refresh runs in the rendered loop, and with a 24 h lead, tokens invalidated about 7 days after issue stay selected under disable-cooling + fill-first (#6742, open). The existing refresh-on-401 in conductor_execution.go and conductor_stream.go does not prevent this. The rejected-token half (credential-scoped 401 in MarkResult, scheduler blocking of expired tokens, markRejectedAccessToken) changes selection for every OAuth provider, including Claude. It is under a day old and unsoaked, so it waits for the next re-pin. The codex_executor_auth.go lead hunk is inside homeEnabled && !hasOuter, so it is Home-only and unreachable with Home off; it is not taken.

fixes.subject: feat(watcher): protect credentials from unindexed deletion during incomplete or in-place file writes
fixes.reason: Not admitted; arrives with the next re-pin. Not reachable: the full-scan window needs an in-place auth-file writer (#6734). After the credential-save-report rewrite, every gateway save stages and renames, including the Codex branch. Management writes are refused. charmer itself writes the auth directory only while the gateway is stopped (snapshot restore, proxy.py:1375). The commit is a 700-line watcher change that overlaps the watcher-parentdir and serve-after-initial-auth-load ports. The credential-save-report rewrite adds the test that keeps it unreachable: no O_TRUNC write to an existing credential path.

fixes.subject: OpenAI-to-Messages tool-call identity and non-stream terminal integrity
fixes.reason: Bounded adaptation (admission 29), not a wholesale translator/performance refactor, on the unchanged 8.0.33 base. The rendered keyed and keyless Messages-to-chat routes can collapse distinct omitted-index tool calls, overwrite an announced call ID and report a non-tool stop reason for converted tool calls in a non-streaming reply. The patch separates explicit indexes from omitted positions, keeps compatible continuations and announced identity stable, joins an index-less fragment to the call that already holds its ID, and reports tool_use for converted tool calls unless the finish reason is length or content_filter, the rule the streaming path already applies. It reconciles the registered legacy-tool-reasoning content-array golden and carries its own stream and non-stream table goldens (gate tool-call-integrity). The golden file is created by cli-proxy-api-openai-content-chunks.patch (22), so omitting 22 also omits this patch, compared with the dependent-only omission. Reservations 26 output-cap, 27 context normalization and 28 logging are unchanged.

fixes.subject: Preserve rejection of the unchanged active SIWC token across outer refresh
fixes.reason: Withdrawn, never shipped; candidate id 30 stays retired. Not reachable with supported credentials: the rejection marker is set only for an access token without an expiry (markRejectedAccessToken, sdk/cliproxy/auth/conductor_refresh.go), every supported SIWC writer requires expires_in > 0 and writes expired, and charmer renders no SIWC sign-in flow, so no supported credential reaches the outer-refresh path this would protect.

fixes.subject: feat(auth): snapshot plugin scheduler and release host lock during executor registration
fixes.reason: Fixes #6744 (ABBA deadlock), which needs plugin records. With plugins disabled the host snapshot is empty, and activeRecordsFromSnapshot returns before Host.mu is taken (internal/pluginhost/snapshot.go:57-60), so credential selection never takes the host lock.

fixes.subject: feat(management): safe Modify for auth records with epoch validation; static and plugin model definitions by channel
fixes.reason: d69962e4 changes management writes (#6733), which remain default-denied. 50cfd238 changes the allowlisted GET /v0/management/model-definitions/:channel read (#6736): an unknown static channel falls back to the plugin host and then GetGlobalRegistry().GetAvailableModelsByProvider(channel), returning registered models instead of 400 when any exist (an empty result still returns 400). This is reachable through the allowlist, but has no credential or route-availability effect and charmer never calls it. On the re-pin that includes it, the allowlist tests must assert both the registered-model fallback and the still-unknown empty case; the v8 counterpart remains refused.
